conditions.displayName: More than ${DENIES_PER_HOUR} denied rules evaluations in an hour

documentation.content: Firestore rules are denying many requests. After a rules or app deploy this usually means the two disagree (a new field the rules do not allow, or a stale rules deploy: CI does not deploy production rules). Users see 'couldn't save' in the mode line. Compare firestore.rules in the repo with the deployed rules in the Firebase console.
